definitions.explanation: A research study conducted with human participants to evaluate the safety and efficacy of new drugs or medical treatments before they are approved for general use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{治験|ちけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A clinical trial for the new drug has begun.

examples.japanese: {治験|ちけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are recruiting patients to participate in the clinical trial.

examples.japanese: {治験|ちけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧で⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}される→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だ。
examples.english: If the clinical trial results are favorable, the drug is expected to be approved next year.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (treatment test). Commonly seen in news about pharmaceutical development. Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic in discussions about vaccine development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {治験|ちけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to conduct a clinical trial)
- {治験|ちけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ (to participate in a clinical trial)
- {治験|ちけん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (clinical trial results)
- {治験|ちけん}{薬|やく} (investigational drug)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臨床試験|りんしょうしけん}: clinical trial — a more formal synonym
- ⟦{知見|ちけん}→知見：13695_chiken⟧: knowledge, insight — a homophone with different kanji and meaning
